verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented, versioned public API with dated releases (2025-04-22 through 2025-11-08) and a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml. The reference covers spaces, objects, properties, types, templates, files and chats, and it runs locally from the desktop app or the headless CLI. The 404 probe only checked doc.anytype.io paths, so it does not contradict the spec published on the developers subdomain. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, a written deprecation policy, an interactive try-it console, and a non-localhost/remote endpoint (v2 is still pre-release).
